RoyalTitleDef.label: Squire
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn attendant learning the duties of arms and service. The first honor earned in service to the North. Northern titles confer standing, not psychic powers, and never forbid honest work.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Hedge Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A landless knight whose courage and kept promises have earned recognition from the North.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Landed Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A knight recognized as worthy of a landed household and its duties. This honor grants standing, not a new settlement.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A recognized head of a northern house, bound to protect the people and honor sworn obligations.

RoyalTitleDef.label: High Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A High Lord, also called a Great Lord, commands the respect of lesser houses and carries greater responsibility for the North.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord Paramount
RoyalTitleDef.description: A paramount ruler, honored above the great houses for exceptional service and leadership.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Warden of the North
RoyalTitleDef.description: The North's highest military guardian, entrusted with its defense against the threats beyond its borders.

RoyalTitleDef.label: King in the North
RoyalTitleDef.description: The greatest honor the North can bestow: recognition as King or Queen in the North. It raises your House's standing, but the North's existing ruler and lands remain their own.
